versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.0

- Initial release of the Wavedash skill.
- Guides users through building, testing, uploading, and publishing browser games on Wavedash.
- Provides structured routing for common tasks, including project setup, SDK integration, multiplayer, achievements, store setup, and quality checks.
- Highlights critical rules and common pitfalls for Wavedash game submissions.
- Emphasizes use of official documentation and safe practices for deployment and automation.
